title: The Mini Orbital Strike TNT Cannon
description:
Meet the Mini Orbital Strike Cannon, a small, simple yet powerful cannon to suit your needs and way cheaper compared to other designs
- Fires only at 1 quadrant ie 90°
- Max range of 2k blocks but theoretically can reach up to 280k blocks if you increase the TNT counter
- Schematic can be rotated and mirrored 

Schematics: https://www.mediafire.com/file/jp5ktriienk0757/Orbital_Strike_cannons.zip/file
How to use it so you can all stop asking: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ulYzq-kfjzw

Important: Make a copy of the calculator and don't bother asking for edit requests, I won't be accepting them
Calculator: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1iM28t0EKDE2-8DN4Rd0XQ99c9JkHYHZcx61XsU-ScmM/edit?usp=sharing
